defaults.notes: Assembled Ball, firmware 0.1.17, device f383571202836e6f. Operator reported completing a roll followed by pickup while the Ball was still moving, a short hold and placement after each visible GO cue. Surface material and independent video ground truth were not recorded. These episodes test the rolling-start pickup path and are not gameplay authority.
